name: MACD explainer
summary: Describe MACD line, signal, and histogram, and compute a simple EMA-based MACD from pasted closes.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Uses EMA(12) − EMA(26) and a 9-period EMA of that difference. Slow educational average, not a live scan of an exchange.
